name: program_bounded_full_goal_delegation
description: Unchanged bounded delegation implementation; the only intervention is adding the observed Object task to caller-side initial routing alongside Spatial and drawer opening. args has only instruction, supplied as the exact complete original goal. Two nonnested literal-range loops provide two primitive call sites, at most eight invocations and 320 control ticks, within the 321-tick operator limit; runtime enforces the 600-second limit. VLA reobserves between chunks. Native terminal success interrupts execution automatically. Any primitive failure is propagated before further motion. Exhaustion returns control without asserting task success and does not itself end the episode. No evaluator query, scene constants, manual gripper intervention, or grasp inference.
